title: The trail-head village
label: invention
$comment: Fen Pass. The rulebook describes a City with seven locations (MH p.46-51) and The 5 Treasures describes a mountain; neither describes this settlement. spec.md's Horizon says 'a trail-head village is a City on fixed data', and this file is that data: the same three locations every run, so the cave has a doorstep that does not change under the player. The village is ours (invention); the procedure each location runs is the book's - the Market table at printed prices (MH p.52-55), the Temple's Spirituality check for +1 LUCK (R58), a night's rest (R40 plus spec.md's sealed +4 ENDURANCE). The Gambling House (R57), the Chaguan (R63) and the City-encounters roll (R65) are city locations this village does not have; see the phase 7 brief's Follow-ups.

records.name: The stall row
records.blurb: Six stalls under one long awning, and the prices are the prices - nobody haggles with someone walking toward the mountain.

records.name: The shrine of the three stars
records.blurb: Sanxing in flaking red lacquer, one bowl of ash between them. Bring incense or bring nothing.

records.name: The last inn
records.blurb: Millet, hot water, and a mat by the wall. The innkeeper does not ask where you are going; she has watched the trail for thirty years.

records.name: The trail to the Flat-top mountain
records.blurb: The path leaves past the last well and climbs. From the switchbacks you can see the flat summit, and the smoke that should not be there.
